title: TelemetryEvent
description: Supply/demand event emitted to Kafka. Producer contract for the Telemetry context; consumed by Flink, never directly by Pricing Decision.

event_id.description: Idempotency key; replays must be safe.

event_time.description: Source-clock time of the fact. Drives point-in-time correctness; ingest time is NOT a substitute.

quantity.description: Units observed/changed. Negative deltas allowed only for InventoryChanged.
